description: On the table in front of you are a banana, an orange, a croissant, a red apple, and two bowls on the right—one blue and one pink—with a green apple initially sitting in the pink bowl. The left hand reaches forward toward the pink bowl, grasps the green apple as a left-hand object, lifts it up and slightly right, then lowers and releases it into the blue bowl while the right hand stays nearby without touching any object.
